title.narrative: Strengthening Public Health Institutions Building Project

description.narrative:
The project will support the People's Republic of China (PRC) in implementing its Healthy China 2030 to improve the quality and services of the health care system; and its Fourteenth Five-Year Plan, 2021-2025 by implementing health system strengthening. The project is aligned with the Asian Development Bank's (ADB) Strategy 2030, accelerating progress in gender equality, strengthening governance and institutional capacity, and fostering regional cooperation and integration; as well as the country partnership strategy for the PRC, 2021-2025 which aims at strengthening national and regional health security under strategic priority 3. It also supports the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal on promoting healthy lives and well-being.
Close consultation with the World Health Organization (WHO) has informed proposed activities and guided adherence to international best practices and standards to advance core capacities for public health. The project is in harmony with sector support of development partners such as the World Bank and Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank.

Fangchenggang: The Preventive Health Care Section of Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital, in cooperation with the Medical Department and the Science Education Section, conducted a training on infectious disease-related knowledge for the whole hospital's medical staff. The content of the training includes diagnosis, treatment, prevention and control of infectious diseases such as influenza, dengue fever, AIDS, etc., management standard of infectious disease report, foodborne disease and cholera monitoring and tumor registration report work standard, etc. More than 900 people participated in the training. Quality of public health services improved

Gender-responsive emergency preparedness and response systems operationalized and fully compliant with World Health Organization standards in the three project sites Progress/Status: Yan'an: TORs for related consulting services are in preparation.
Guiyang: The project has successfully completed 13 preparatory procedures, with one outstanding item (the principal construction permit) pending to be dealt with upon the conclusion of the GY-CW1 tendering process. All individual architectural construction drawings and geological survey reports for this project have been reviewed and approved by the city's design and quality control station, acquiring their respective certificates of compliance. The site leveling work has already been accomplished, and the ongoing efforts for foundation pit slope reinforcement and earthwork engineering are steadily advancing. The procurement project GY-CW1 conducted its public opening and evaluation session on February 6th at the Guiyang City Public Resources Trading Center.
